scenario.setting: Indoor environment with stairs, such as an office building or warehouse.
scenario.robot_task: Transport a package from one floor to another using the stairs.
scenario.cause_of_danger: Robot misjudges the edge of a step due to sensor error or obstacle occlusion.
scenario.result_of_danger: Human trips over the robot and falls, potentially causing injuries like sprains or fractures.
scenario.danger_action: Robot abruptly stops or shifts position on a stair step while a human is descending nearby.
scenario.instantaneous_solution: Robot detects human proximity with sensors, pauses movement, and emits an audible alert to warn the human before proceeding.
scenario.assumptions: Robot is equipped with basic proximity sensors and can perform simple stop-and-alert actions in response to detected obstacles.

from unified_planning.shortcuts import *
from src.planner.solver import BasePlanner

class DomainPlanner(BasePlanner):
    """
    DOMAIN: Stairs Delivery Safety Planning
    
    This domain models a delivery robot transporting packages between floors using stairs.
    The danger occurs when the robot misjudges step edges and causes humans to trip.
    """
    
    def __init__(self):
        super().__init__()
        
        # ===== DOMAIN-SPECIFIC TYPES (CHANGE FOR NEW DOMAINS) =====
        self.Location = UserType("Location")
        self.ObjectType = UserType("ObjectType")
        
        # ===== DOMAIN-SPECIFIC OBJECTS (CHANGE FOR NEW DOMAINS) =====
        self.bottom_stairs = Object("bottom_stairs", self.Location)
        self.middle_stairs = Object("middle_stairs", self.Location)
        self.top_stairs = Object("top_stairs", self.Location)
        self.destination = Object("destination", self.Location)
        self.package = Object("package", self.ObjectType)
        
        # ===== DOMAIN-SPECIFIC FLUENTS (CHANGE FOR NEW DOMAINS) =====
        # Normal fluents
        self.robot_at = Fluent("robot_at", BoolType(), position=self.Location)
        self.package_at = Fluent("package_at", BoolType(), obj=self.ObjectType, position=self.Location)
        self.robot_has = Fluent("robot_has", BoolType(), obj=self.ObjectType)
        self.human_nearby = Fluent("human_nearby", BoolType())
        self.robot_moving = Fluent("robot_moving", BoolType())
        self.alert_sounded = Fluent("alert_sounded", BoolType())

        # Context fluents
        self.setting_has_stairs = Fluent("setting_has_stairs", BoolType())
        self.robot_has_proximity_sensors = Fluent("robot_has_proximity_sensors", BoolType())
        self.robot_has_audible_alert = Fluent("robot_has_audible_alert", BoolType())
        self.stairs_have_occlusion_risk = Fluent("stairs_have_occlusion_risk", BoolType())

        # ===== SAFETY FLUENT (KEEP THIS STRUCTURE) =====
        self.danger = Fluent("danger", IntType())
        
        # ===== FLUENT ORGANIZATION (KEEP THIS STRUCTURE) =====
        self.normal_fluents = [self.robot_at, self.package_at, self.robot_has, self.human_nearby, self.robot_moving, self.alert_sounded]
        self.context_fluents = [self.setting_has_stairs, self.robot_has_proximity_sensors, self.robot_has_audible_alert, self.stairs_have_occlusion_risk]
        self.safety_fluents = [self.danger]
        self.objects = [self.bottom_stairs, self.middle_stairs, self.top_stairs, self.destination, self.package]

    def create_base_actions(self):
        """
        Create all base actions for the domain.
        """
        # ===== DOMAIN-SPECIFIC ACTIONS (CHANGE FOR NEW DOMAINS) =====
        
        # Navigation actions
        navigate_to_bottom_stairs = InstantaneousAction("navigate_to_bottom_stairs")
        navigate_to_bottom_stairs.add_precondition(Not(self.robot_at(self.bottom_stairs)))
        navigate_to_bottom_stairs.add_effect(self.robot_at(self.middle_stairs), False)
        navigate_to_bottom_stairs.add_effect(self.robot_at(self.top_stairs), False)
        navigate_to_bottom_stairs.add_effect(self.robot_at(self.destination), False)
        navigate_to_bottom_stairs.add_effect(self.robot_at(self.bottom_stairs), True)
        navigate_to_bottom_stairs.add_effect(self.robot_moving, True)

        navigate_to_middle_stairs = InstantaneousAction("navigate_to_middle_stairs")
        navigate_to_middle_stairs.add_precondition(self.robot_at(self.bottom_stairs))
        navigate_to_middle_stairs.add_precondition(Not(self.robot_at(self.middle_stairs)))
        navigate_to_middle_stairs.add_effect(self.robot_at(self.bottom_stairs), False)
        navigate_to_middle_stairs.add_effect(self.robot_at(self.top_stairs), False)
        navigate_to_middle_stairs.add_effect(self.robot_at(self.destination), False)
        navigate_to_middle_stairs.add_effect(self.robot_at(self.middle_stairs), True)
        navigate_to_middle_stairs.add_effect(self.robot_moving, True)

        navigate_to_top_stairs = InstantaneousAction("navigate_to_top_stairs")
        navigate_to_top_stairs.add_precondition(self.robot_at(self.middle_stairs))
        navigate_to_top_stairs.add_precondition(Not(self.robot_at(self.top_stairs)))
        navigate_to_top_stairs.add_effect(self.robot_at(self.bottom_stairs), False)
        navigate_to_top_stairs.add_effect(self.robot_at(self.middle_stairs), False)
        navigate_to_top_stairs.add_effect(self.robot_at(self.destination), False)
        navigate_to_top_stairs.add_effect(self.robot_at(self.top_stairs), True)
        navigate_to_top_stairs.add_effect(self.robot_moving, True)

        navigate_to_destination = InstantaneousAction("navigate_to_destination")
        navigate_to_destination.add_precondition(self.robot_at(self.top_stairs))
        navigate_to_destination.add_precondition(Not(self.robot_at(self.destination)))
        navigate_to_destination.add_effect(self.robot_at(self.bottom_stairs), False)
        navigate_to_destination.add_effect(self.robot_at(self.middle_stairs), False)
        navigate_to_destination.add_effect(self.robot_at(self.top_stairs), False)
        navigate_to_destination.add_effect(self.robot_at(self.destination), True)
        navigate_to_destination.add_effect(self.robot_moving, True)

        # Package handling actions
        grab_package = InstantaneousAction("grab_package")
        grab_package.add_precondition(self.robot_at(self.bottom_stairs))
        grab_package.add_precondition(self.package_at(self.package, self.bottom_stairs))
        grab_package.add_precondition(Not(self.robot_has(self.package)))
        grab_package.add_effect(self.package_at(self.package, self.bottom_stairs), False)
        grab_package.add_effect(self.robot_has(self.package), True)

        place_package = InstantaneousAction("place_package")
        place_package.add_precondition(self.robot_at(self.destination))
        place_package.add_precondition(self.robot_has(self.package))
        place_package.add_effect(self.package_at(self.package, self.destination), True)
        place_package.add_effect(self.robot_has(self.package), False)

        # Safety actions
        pause_movement = InstantaneousAction("pause_movement")
        pause_movement.add_precondition(self.robot_moving)
        pause_movement.add_effect(self.robot_moving, False)

        sound_alert = InstantaneousAction("sound_alert")
        sound_alert.add_precondition(Not(self.alert_sounded))
        sound_alert.add_effect(self.alert_sounded, True)

        resume_movement = InstantaneousAction("resume_movement")
        resume_movement.add_precondition(Not(self.robot_moving))
        resume_movement.add_effect(self.robot_moving, True)
        resume_movement.add_effect(self.alert_sounded, False)

        return navigate_to_bottom_stairs, navigate_to_middle_stairs, navigate_to_top_stairs, navigate_to_destination, grab_package, place_package, pause_movement, sound_alert, resume_movement

    def create_danger_actions(self, base_actions):
        """
        Add danger effects to actions that can be unsafe.
        """
        # ===== DOMAIN-SPECIFIC DANGER EFFECTS (CHANGE FOR NEW DOMAINS) =====
        dangerous_actions = {
            "navigate_to_middle_stairs": And([
                self.robot_moving,
                self.human_nearby,
                self.stairs_have_occlusion_risk,
                Not(self.alert_sounded)
            ]),  # Moving on stairs with human nearby and no alert is dangerous
            "navigate_to_top_stairs": And([
                self.robot_moving,
                self.human_nearby,
                self.stairs_have_occlusion_risk,
                Not(self.alert_sounded)
            ]),  # Moving on stairs with human nearby and no alert is dangerous
        }
        
        # ===== INFRASTRUCTURE (KEEP THIS LINE) =====
        return self.apply_danger_effects(base_actions, dangerous_actions)

    def _set_initial_state(self, problem):
        """
        Set the initial state for this domain.
        """
        # ===== DOMAIN-SPECIFIC INITIAL STATE (CHANGE FOR NEW DOMAINS) =====
        problem.set_initial_value(self.robot_at(self.bottom_stairs), True)
        problem.set_initial_value(self.package_at(self.package, self.bottom_stairs), True)
        problem.set_initial_value(self.human_nearby, True)
        problem.set_initial_value(self.robot_moving, False)
        problem.set_initial_value(self.alert_sounded, False)
        problem.set_initial_value(self.setting_has_stairs, True)
        problem.set_initial_value(self.robot_has_proximity_sensors, True)
        problem.set_initial_value(self.robot_has_audible_alert, True)
        problem.set_initial_value(self.stairs_have_occlusion_risk, True)

    def _set_goals(self, problem):
        """
        Set the goals for this domain.
        """
        # ===== DOMAIN-SPECIFIC GOALS (CHANGE FOR NEW DOMAINS) =====
        problem.add_goal(self.package_at(self.package, self.destination))

# ===== INFRASTRUCTURE (KEEP THIS EXACTLY) =====
if __name__ == "__main__":
    DomainPlanner().run_cli()
